data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Pāwhiritia te whirihoranga mō tētahi tūmau o mua, whakamahi rānei i te matapihi tāuta i te wa e hanga ana i tētahi. Hurihia anake nga mara e pa ana ki to taakaro.
KAUPAPA ME TE WHAKAMAHI i mua Ko te aratau tīmatanga e akiaki ana i nga tautuhinga noa me te whakahau whakarewa e taunakitia ana. Ko te aratau matatau e whakaatu ana i nga mana hangarau taapiri, tae atu ki te RCON tautoko me nga waahanga whakarewa raw. Kāore te huri i ngā aratau e whakakore ana i ngā uara kua tiakina. E wātea ana nga whakamohio Discord i roto i ngā aratau e rua.
Ko te aha e tirohia ana e ia whārangi • General: Ingoa tūmau, kēmu, putanga / putanga, me te tautoko kōwhiringa hōputu gameplay. • Haumarutanga: Nga kupuhipa me etahi atu tautuhinga urunga e tautokohia ana e te tauira. • World Generation: Te ingoa o te ao, te purapura, te rahi, me nga kōwhiringa o te ao e pa ana. • Whatunga & RCON: Ka tautokohia te taakaro, te uiui, te hoa / API, me nga waahanga mutunga whakahaere. • Aunoa: Te tārua / te whakahou i runga i te tiimata me te tiaki kua whakaritea. • Discord: Nga waahi whakamohio me te arahi huihuinga. • Tāuta & Whakarewa: Te kōpaki tāutanga me ngā kōwhiringa whakarewa e tautokohia ana.
Ko ngā mara kua whakakorehia mō te kēmu he whānuitanga. Ka taea e tētahi kēmu te whai i taua whakatakotoranga ake, kāore rānei he tautoko mō taua whakatakotoranga; Ehara i te mea haumaru te whakakakahu i ngā kōrero anō ki te whakahau.
E whā ngā tohu whakamātautau Nga taipitopito o te tūmau → Nga tautuhinga e hiahiatia ana → Arotake → Whakaorangia te tūmau
E whai enei rite whirihoranga, e kore te tikiake, te tāuta haere. I te wa e haere ana nga tautuhinga e hiahiatia ana ki te whakamana, ka whakatuwherahia e Synix te taahiraa 3 kia taea ai e koe te arotake i o whiringa, ka whakatuwherahia a Save Server. Te huri i tētahi tautuhinga kōpaki Whakaorangia anō kia kitea ai ngā kōwhiringa kua whakahoutia i roto i te Arotake. Me whiriwhiri koe ki te whakaora i a koe; te whakatuwheratanga Arotake e kore e whakaora aunoa. Pānuihia te karere tonu o te raro, ina hiahiatia e tētahi he aro nui.
I te wa e whakatika ana i tētahi tūmau, kati i te tuatahi mēnā ka pā te huringa ki ngā kōnae, ki ngā kōwhiringa rānei e pānuihia ana i te tīmatanga. Ka whakahoutia e Save Changes tōna pūkete; kāore e kī ana kua whakamahia ēnei uara e tētahi kēmu rere. Whakahoutia te Synix i te wa e hiahiatia ana e te kēmu.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Whakatūwhera Configure → Automatism mo te tūmau tīpakohia ki te whiriwhiri i te mahi e tupu i mua i te whakarewatanga tautoko.
Hoki ki te Tīmata Whakahohe tenei ki te hanga i tētahi tārua tūmau mutu i mua i te tīmata e hāngai ana. Whakaturia te pakiaka pūtake me te pupuri i roto i ngā tautuhinga tono → Pūtake.
Ka tīmata te whakaoranga o te hingatanga ki te whakarere i te mahi tiaki noa. Kāore ngā pūrua whakaoho aunoa e whakakapi ana i te pupuri i ngā wāhi whakaora motuhake i mua i ngā huringa nui.
WHAKAMAHI ON START Whakahohehia tenei ki te whakahaere i te tirotiro whakahou kēmu tautoko i mua i te whakarewa. Ka whakahoutia e ia ngā kōnae kaitākaro, ehara i te tono Synix.
Ko te tirotiro whakahou ehara i te kupu whakaari ka tango nga konae i nga timatanga katoa. Ko SteamCMD me te kaiwhakangungu o te kēmu e whakatau ana he aha te mea e hiahiatia ana.
KAUPAPAPA me nga kōnae ritenga Ka taea e te mahi ā-ringa Validate te whakatika, te tikiake anō rānei i ngā kōnae e whakahaerehia ana e te kaiwhakanao. Kia mau tonu ngā whakarerekētanga i mua i te whakahou, i te whakamana rānei; kaua e whakaaro kei noho tonu ngā kōnae ritenga.
Whakamātauria ō kōwhiringa Whakaorangia ngā tautuhinga, me te whakahaere i tētahi tīmatanga whai wāhi. Pānuihia nga hua o te mahi hei tārua, whakahou, me te whakarewa. Ko te tikiake oti i te kēmu kāore e whakaatu ana kua pai te utaina o tōna ao.
Tukua he wāhi noa mō ngā pūranga, ngā tikiake, ngā kōnae wā, me te kēmu tāuta. Ki te pūrongo te mahi i mua i te tīmatanga he hapa, rangahau i te take i whakaaturia, kaua ki te whakarewa i te tūmau kotahi i waho o Synix ki te whakarereke i te reira.

data.name: Content.CEABA321348E0751E652
data.value: Nga Whakaaetanga me te Whakaaetanga

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Whakatuwherahia te Whakaritea mo te tūmau kua tohua i mua i tana tiimata tuatahi, i te wa ranei ka raru tetahi mea. Ka kohia e ia nga tirotiro e tautokohia ana e taua pūkete, penei i nga konae, nga wa whakahaere, te whirihoranga, te mokowā kōpae, nga tauranga, te āhua o te tukanga, me nga tuhinga e pa ana.
Kia mārama ki te hua • He rite: Kaore he raru aukati i kitea e nga tirotiro e waatea ana. • Arotake: Pānuitia te kitenga, me whakatau mēnā e hiahiatia ana he mahi. • Kua aukatihia: Whakamutua te take i whakahuatia i mua i te haere tonu.
Ehara i te mea ko te rite te mahi aunoa i nga whakahoutanga katoa e tūtohutia ana. Tirohia te mahi e tūtohutia ana me tōna whakamana.
Whai muri i te whakaoranga i tētahi pūkete hou Ka taea e te Tīmata tuatahi te tango i nga konae, te whakauru i te wa rere tautoko, te whakaputa whirihoranga, me te tatari mo te tiimata o te keemu. Te whai i te aratohu tīmata tuatahi me Activity & Diagnostics hei utu i te whakawhiwhia ki te tapanga o te papapātuhi kua tiakina hei kēmu tāuta.
E hiahiatia ana e ētahi kēmu he whakaaetanga, he whakamanaatanga, he whakatakotoranga tono/whāinga rānei i roto i te kēmu i mua i te uru atu o tetahi. Whakamutunga i taua taahiraa i te wahi e hiahiatia ana e te kēmu.
KAUPAPAPAGA o te hototahi Tāuta, Tīmata, Whakamutua, me te aroturuki hua tuhi mahi Synix kua kite. Kāore i oti te whakamātautau engari kaore he hua kua tuhia; ehara i te mea e mohiotia ana kua pakaru te kēmu.
Ko te hua Ready, he whakamātautau ā-rohe angitu rānei ehara i te ti'aturi mo te uru atu ki te ipurangi, i ngā pūmanawa hauora, i te hototahi rānei ki ngā kiritaki katoa. Whakamutua mā te whakamātautau i te hononga me te ao e hiahiatia ana.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Ko te pūrua tūmau-whiriwhiria tiaki kōnae i roto i te kōpaki tāutanga o taua tūmau. Tirohia i hea te kēmu e whakaora ana i tona ao i mua i te whakawhirinaki ki a ia.
Hangaia he Putanga 1. Whakamutua te tūmau mā Synix me te tatari kia puta ake ōna tukanga. 2. Tīpakohia te mahi tārua i roto i ngā Kōwhiringa Tūmau. 3. Tirohia te pūtake, te ūnga, te rahi tata, me te wāhi kōpae e wātea ana. 4. Whakaaetia me te tatari kia oti. 5. Pāwhiritia te Kōpaki Tōmua Whakatuwhera ki te rapu i te pūranga. Kia mau ki a ia tana whiwhinga.
KAUPAPAPA Kei roto i te tārua te kōpaki tāutanga, e kore anake he kōpaki whakaora iti. Ka hiahiatia pea e ngā kēmu nui he wā nui me te rokiroki.
Kei waho pea o taua kōpaki ngā penapena i roto i te AppData, Tuhinga, tetahi atu puku, i tētahi mīhini mariko rānei o te kēmu. Whakaaetia ēnei ā-iwi mā te whakamahi i te tikanga tautoko o te kēmu.
TE WHAKAMAHI me te WHAKAMAHI Ko te pakiaka tārua noa ko C:\Synix\BackupGames. Tautuhinga → Tārua e taea ai e koe te whiriwhiri i tētahi atu pakiaka, me te tautuhi i te rohe whakaora-tārua.
Ko te ūnga me noho ki waho o te kōpaki tūmau puna. Te huri i te pakiaka taapiri kaore e neke, e muku ranei i nga tuhinga o mua; tirohia te wāhi tawhito mō ngā pūrua tawhito.
Ka whakakorea e te pupuri ngā pūranga tawhito ina neke ake i te rohe kua whakaritea i te wā o te hanga tārua. Kia mau tonu ngā wāhi whakaora i waho o taua wāhi tāpui.
Whakaorangia tētahi atu kape whakapumautia o ngā ao nui i runga i te rokiroki motuhake. Ka taea e tētahi kōpae kua pahemo te whakangaro i te tūmau me ngā pūrua kei runga i taua kōpae kotahi. Ko te ZIP o te kōpaki whakatakotoranga o waho ehara i te pūrere pūrua me te pātengi raraunga.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Pānuihia te karere tika o Windows i mua i te whakatau he aha te whakarereke. He raruraru rerekē tētahi pūmanawa whakahohe kua aukatia, he hapa uru kōnae, me te wā rere o te kēmu e ngaro ana.
Kaore e taea te whakauru, te whakatuwhera ranei i te SYNIX Whakamahia he putanga mana, te kōpaki tika rānei o WinGet ubidzz.Synix Ki te whakakapi i tētahi kōnae e pūrongo ana kua whakakahoretia te uru, kati te tauira Synix mā te whakamahi i taua ara me te whakamātau anō. Tirohia te urunga kōpaki me ngā karere pūmanawa haumaru mēnā kei te haere tonu te raruraru.
Kaua e muku i nga raraunga tūmau, kaua hoki e whakakore i te tiaki hei whakatika whānui.
Ko te Whakaaturanga Ataata Ka taea e te whakatupato ingoa te tuku Atu mōhiohio → Run ahakoa, i runga i te kaupapa here Windows. Ko te aroaro o taua kōwhiringa ehara i te tohu he haumaru tētahi kōnae. Tirohia te pūtake mana me te tirotiro i te whakatupato i mua i te whakatau mehemea ka haere tonu.
KAUPAPA I te APP AKARIA Ka taea e tēnei te aukati i tētahi taupānga mēnā kāore e taea e Windows te whakapumautia he whakawhirinaki nui. E kore e whai i te takitahi-paiha taupānga whakataurite ki SmartScreen's Run ahakoa. Kaua e whakakore i ngā āhuatanga haumaru o te Windows hei whakahaere anake i te Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Whakamātauria te kitenga tūturu me te kōnae. Kaua e whakaaro ko te whakatupato he tohu teka, no te mea ko te ingoa o te kōnae Synix. Ko te pūkete SHA-256 e ōrite ana ka tautuhi i te konae kua tikiake; kaore e whakapumautia he whakawhirinaki, he waehere tohu ranei.
Whakatika te tikanga whakatupato me te tāuta tika me ngā taipitopito tūmataiti i tangohia. Me karo i nga whakakore noa, me te whakarereke ranei i te tirotiro hash o te kaiwhakangungu.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Whakamahia nga Tautuhinga → Pūrere Tōmua mo te kaweake / kawemai Synix katoa. He rerekē tēnei i te rēhita i tētahi kōpaki tūmau o mua.
Tirohia te mea e tika ana kia neke Ko te kohinga kaweake ko te rakau matua o C:\Synix. E hiahia ana te tūmau ritenga ranei kōpaki tārua i waho o reira, me te whakaora kēmu o waho whakahaere motuhake. Tuhia o rātau ara i mua i te tīmatanga. Ko nga hiahia Windows noa ka hiahiatia pea te arotake i runga i te waahi e haere ai.
Te kaweake 1. Whakamutua ngā tūmau me te whakaoti i te tiaki, te tango, me te tārua. 2. Kōwhiria te whakamunatanga, te kaweake noa rānei. 3. Tīpakohia tētahi ūnga i waho o te rākau pūtake, me te arotake i te rahi me ngā whakaritenga wāhi wā. 4. Mo te kaweake whakamunatanga, tīpakohia he kupuhipa whakawhiti kaha me te rokiroki motuhake. 5. Kia tatari kia oti te kohinga .synixbackup, ka tirohia.
Whiriwhiria te tiaki tika Ko te kaweake whakamunatanga e tiaki ana i te kohinga me te tautoko i te whakawhiti kawe o nga tohu tautoko ki te kaute Windows haerenga.
E kore e whakamunatia te kaweake noa. Ka taea e ngā kōnae kēmu me ngā rārangipāpāho kei roto i a ia te whakapuaki i ngā mea ngaro. Ko te kape i nga uara whakamunatanga e herea ana ki a Windows kaore e taea te whakamahi i a raatau ki tetahi atu kaute.
Te kaweake 1. Whakahoki i ngā raraunga Synix o te ūnga tuatahi. 2. Whakatūwherahia ngā aratohu kawemai/whakatau me te tīpako i te kōpaki e hiahiatia ana. 3. Tukuna te kupuhipa whakawhiti ki te tono me te tirotiro i te kohinga. 4. Tirohia te ūnga, ngā whakaritenga kōpae, me te tuhi anō i ngā whakatupato. 5. Kia oti te whakakotahitanga, te whakamana me te whakaora. 6. Tirohia ngā ara tūmau, ngā tauranga, ngā hōtaka, ngā wāhi tārua, me ngā mōhiohio i mua i te tīmata i tētahi mea.
Whakauruhia anō a Satisfactory mēnā kāore e ōrite ana te tuakiri ā-rohe, te hononga ā-rohe rānei. Kia mau ki te kohinga taketake me nga raraunga tawhito tae noa ki te whakamātautau o ngā tūmau kawemai.
Ko nga whakawhitinga raraunga e tautokohia ana ka pupuri i tētahi kape o te pātengi raraunga i mua i te whakawhitinga. Ki te kore e taea te kawemai, te neke ranei, kia mau taua kape me te karere whakaora hei utu i te whakakapi i te pātengi raraunga kaha i te wa e rere ana a Synix.

data.name: Content.DF87160BA314A6D2E7F5
data.value: KAUPAPA KAUPAPAPA

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Whakauruhia me te Whakarewa kei roto i te kōpaki tūmau kua tohua me ona kōwhiringa whakarewa tautoko. Kia mau ki te whakahau e tūtohutia ana mēnā kāore koe i te mōhio ki te tātaitanga o ngā tautohetohe o te kēmu.
KAUPAPAPA I ngā kōrero Whakamahia te aratau Advanced ina hiahiatia ana nga tautohe raw. Tirohia te whakahua, nga ara whakahaere, me nga ingoa o nga waahanga e hiahiatia ana e te keemu. Ko te Synix e whakarato ana i nga tautohetohe whakahaere e tautokohia ana; ka taea e te tāpiri i tētahi atu kape te whakaputa i ngā tautuhinga tautohetohe.
Kaua e whakamāori i ngā whakawhiti, kaua hoki e whakakapi i tētahi uara hangarau e tūmanakotia ana ki tōna taitara whakamāori. Kaua rawa e tāpiri i ngā mōhiohio ki tētahi whakahau kia ngāwari ake ai te tārua.
Ngā kōnae whakarewatanga kaweake Mō ngā pūkete tautoko, Ko nga Kōwhiringa Tūmau → Waihanga i te Pūrere Rōpū e tuhi ana i te whakahau whakarewa kua oti te whakaoti ki tētahi tuhinga.
Ka taea e taua kōnae te whakauru i ngā kupuhipa pānui, i ngā tohu ratonga rānei kia taea ai te whakahaere motuhake. Kia tūmataiti, ā, tirohia i mua i te tohatoha, i te neke rānei.
Te whakahaere i te tuhinga i waho o Synix e kore e whakarato i nga raka mahi katoa o Synix, te whakatikatika o te kaitirotiro, nga tārua, te tiaki i whakaritea ranei. Kaua e whakahaere i te reira i te wā Synix kua oti te mahi i taua tūmau.
KAUPAPAPA I waho Ka whakarewahia e ētahi pūkete petipeti o rātou ake taputapu whakatakotoranga hei utu i tētahi tukanga tūmau noa iho. Ka hiahiatia pea e aua taputapu he tono whakaaetanga motuhake, a kaore pea e tautoko i te kaweake o nga konae whakarewa. Me whai i te aratohu kēmu o te pūkete, kaua ki te whakakapi i tētahi atu whakahaeretia ranei.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Whakamahia he kohinga tuku mana. Kei roto i te wā whakahaere .NET e hiahiatia ana e Synix; pea e hiahia ana ngā tūmau kēmu ki ō rātou ake whakaritenga.
Whiriwhiria he tikanga tāutanga • MSI: Tikiake a SynixSetup.msi, whakahaerehia, ka whakatuwhera i a Synix Control Panel mai i te tahua Tīmata. Ko te waahi tono noa mo ia kaiwhakamahi ko %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Whakamahia te kohinga tika.Synix. Kei roto i te tuhinga WinGet Whakauruhia me nga Whakahoutanga nga whakahau. • Ka taea te whakahaere motuhake: Whakanohohia te tikiake motuhake mana i roto i tetahi kōpaki ka taea te tuhi, ka rere ki reira. Ko te neke i taua mea whakahohe ehara i te whakawhitinga katoa o ō tūmau.
Ngā tikiake ā-motu: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Whakahoutia te APPLICATION 1. Whakamutua nga tikiake, te tārua, me te tiaki. 2. Whakamutua ō tūmau kēmu mā Synix me te kati i a Synix kia rite ki te tikanga. 3. Whakamahia te whakahoutia, te tāuta rānei mō tō tikanga tāutanga i tīpakohia. 4. Whakatūwhera anō Synix me te tirotiro mēnā he tika ō tāuru tūmau me ngā ara.
Ki te whakakapi i te tāuta tawhito EXE e hāngai ana ki te MSI, uninstall te tono tawhito tuatahi. Me pupuri i ngā raraunga tūmau me ngā kōpaki tūmau ritenga. Kaua e mukua C:\Synix ki te whakahou i te hōtaka.
Kaore he whakahou tono e whakahou i nga keemu e whakahaerehia ana e koe. Whakamahia te mahi Whakahoutia o te tūmau kua tohua mo taua mea.
Mena e kii ana a Windows kua whakakahoretia te urunga i te wa e whakakapi ana i te kaiwhakawhanake, tirohia kaore ano kia rere te kape e whakakapihia ana. Kaua e whakakahoretia he tono kei te whakahaere, kaua hoki e tango i nga raraunga tūmau hei mahi ki te huri i te hapa.

data.name: Content.EA74D510F0EB0B4AEEFA
data.value:
E hiahiatia ana te whakatakotoranga whakahirahira:
1. Whakatikahia te tūmau kotahi ki te hanga i te hoahoa whirihoranga JSON, ka kati.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Ka tirohia e Synix te pēhanga rauemi i mua i etahi whakarewa hei whakaiti i te tupono o te nui o te kawenga. Mena ka whakaroa te tiimata, ka aukati ranei, panuihia te take rauemi i whakahuatia.
Kia WHAKAMAHI ki te Kaiwhakarite Whakaaetia te mahara mo Windows me nga tono papamuri me te keemu. Kia wātea te wāhi kōpae mō ngā whakahoutanga, ngā kōnae wā, te penapena, me ngā pūrua.
Ko te rohe mahara Minecraft kua whirihora ka pa ki tana kēmu / wa whakahaere. Ehara tēnei i te rohe mārō o te ao mō ngā tukanga katoa e whakarewahia ana e ia kēmu.
Kāore te tirotiro rauemi e tuku i tētahi tūmau ki roto i tētahi ipu CPU/RAM, ā, kāore rānei e whakarite kia kore e mutu ngā rauemi o te Windows. Whakamahia te aroturuki rauemi me te whakarāpopototanga papapātuhi PC katoa ki te mohio ki te kawenga tūturu.
KAUPAPA KAUPAPAPA Ko te āhuatanga whakatupato whatunga whakamātautau e aroturuki i ngā āhuatanga whānuitanga taiaho / rauemi ohorere, me te pūkete mō te mahi SteamCMD mohiotia ki te whakaiti whakatupato teka.
Ehara tēnei i te pā ahi, i te kōpaki taraiwa, i te ratonga tiaki DDoS rānei. Kāore te whakatupato e tohu ana i tētahi kaiwhaiwhai, kāore rānei e whakaatu ana he whakaeke i puta.
Ka whakatupatohia, whakataurite te mahi ki nga tono kua tāruahia, ngā pūrua, me ētahi atu taupānga. Tirohia ngā rārangipāpāho e hāngai ana i mua i te huri i ngā tautuhinga haumaru, whatunga rānei.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Whiriwhiria te pūkete Rust me te arotake i tona ao, tuakiri, gameplay, pātai, me te hoa tautuhinga i mua i te tīmatanga tuatahi.
TE KAUPAPAGA o te Kaiwhakahaere Ka whakaratohia e Synix te uara +server.identity tautoko mai i te tuakiri o te tūmau. Kia mau ngā whakatūnga motuhake me ngā tuakiri mō ngā take motuhake kia kore ai e tohaina e rātau he ao, he whirihoranga rānei.
RUST+ Whakaritehia he Port App tautoko motuhake mo te ratonga hoa, ka whai i nga whakaritenga hono me te whatunga a Rust. E wehe ana tōna mutunga i te tākaro kaitākaro me te whakahaere kōwhiringa RCON.
Tirohia nga tauranga kua whirihorahia, kaua ki te kape i tetahi ture mai i tetahi atu kaituku Rust. Tiakina nga tohu RCON me te kore e whakaputaina hei awhina i nga tangata ki te whakauru.
VANILLA A me te Oxide Kei te whakamahi a Vanilla i ngā kōnae tūmau mana. Ka tāpirihia e te kōwhiringa Oxide te anga mana tautoko i muri i ngā kōnae Steam. Kāore te tāutanga anga e tīpako ana, e kore hoki e aroturuki i ngā tāpiri takitahi.
Whakamahia te mahinga mahi a-rohe o te Kaiwhakahaere Mod & Plugin mo te whakauru Oxide / uMod i kitea. Kei te hiahia tonu a Plugins ki nga putanga hototahi me nga puna pono.
Ka whakamahia anō e Synix te wā whakahaere Oxide e tautokohia ana i muri i ngā whakahoutanga, i te whakamana rānei o te Rust ina tīpakohia taua anga. Hei hoki ki nga konae Vanilla mana, hurihia te kōwhiringa anga me te whakahaere i te mahinga mahi Whakahoutia, Whakapaipai ranei.
I mua i te huringa o te anga me te keemu, puritia te ao, te whirihoranga, me nga raraunga taapiri. Tirohia ngā rārangipāpāho kēmu me ngā rārangipāpāho Oxide i muri i te tīmata anō; e kore te tikiake anga angitu e whakaatu e tika ana te utaina o nga taapiri katoa.

Whakamahia te tāuta tūmau mahi me ngā ara kōpaki. Ko nga mod mo te kiritaki anake he wehe; kia mau tonu ngā tārua kōpaki i mua i te huri i ngā mod o te tūmau.

Kia tuwhera te Synix, kia iti rānei. Ko te hononga puku e whakarongo ana ki te takiuru. Ka whakahoutia nga taipitopito tūmau i ia 10 hēkona i te wa e tirohia ana. Ko te whakakore i nga hononga ka whakakore i te uru mamao me te kore e aukati i nga kaituku.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Waihangatia he kupuhipa rangitahi i konei. Takiuru ki te paetukutuku mā taua kupuhipa me tō tikanga 2FA, tō kī uru (passkey) rānei e whakamahia ana, kātahi ka kōwhiri i tētahi kupuhipa hou. Ki te hiahiatia ngā tikanga e rua, ka noho herea tonu ngā mea e rua. Kotahi anake te whakamahinga o te kupuhipa rangitahi, ā, ka pau te wā i muri i te 10 meneti. Ka whai mana tonu tō kupuhipa taketake kia oti rā anō te whakaora.
